glosses: command; order (demand for someone to do something)

examples.en: I write letters which I never send.

examples.text: Esta é a primeira vez que eu mando flores para a Mary.
examples.en: This is the first time I've sent flowers to Mary.

examples.text: Tom sabia que, a mando de Mary, John pediu para Alice não fazer isso.
examples.en: Tom knew Mary told John to ask Alice not to do that.
